observations: The page number «101» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 completes the sentence that ends p. 100 (JP2 0132, L37), «hier findet».

L01-L09 and N04-N05. Checked: 26° 45′ + 53° 30′ = 80° 15′; 80° 23′ − 80° 15′ = 8′; 25° − 7′ = 24° 53′ of Cancer, 114° 53′; the planet at 65° and 60° more give 125°, 5° of Leo, 10° 7′ beyond 114° 53′, «c. 10°». The entries of Table 94 are to be compared with the table.

L10-L20. Checked: 317° = 17° of Aquarius, 138° = 18° of Leo; 14° 16′ + 49° 28′ = 63° 44′; 3° 55′ − 3° 40′ = 15′ for 5° of the horoscope, 15′ · 2 : 5 = 6′; 3° 40′ + 6′ = 3° 46′ of Scorpio. L21-L27. Checked: 335° = 5° of Pisces, 115° = 25° of Cancer; 117° 13′ + 48° 19′ = 165° 32′; 165° 32′ − 144° 58′ = 20° 34′. The entries of Tables 111-113 are to be compared with the tables.

L28-L33. Checked: counted on the ecliptic from the planet at λ, the left aspects lie at λ + 60°, λ + 90°, λ + 120°, the right ones at λ − 60°, λ − 90°, λ − 120°; λ − 120° = (λ + 60°) − 180°, λ − 90° = (λ + 90°) − 180°, λ − 60° = (λ + 120°) − 180°, the three rules of L30-L32, and the rule of L07-L09. 24° 53′ of Cancer and 180° give 24° 53′ of Capricorn, as L33 says.

L30-L32: the three rules set as a small table, the ditto marks «„» under the words they repeat: twice under «Der rechte», five times under «ist der Nadir des linken». Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cell gives the fourth column room.
The dashes: L06 «80° 23′ — 80° 15′», the minus a long dash (47 px) with a space on either side; L26 «1.—2. Kolonne», the long dash (44 px) set close.
Small marks in L08 («Trigonalscheins»), after «Trigonalschein,» (N02) and after «steht.» (N03); not transcribed.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.»; italics: «Exagonum», «ascensio obliqua», «linken Sextilscheins», «Horoskop», «Länge» (L10, L21), «Quindecim gradus Aquarii,», «Quinque gradus Piscium», «linken», «rechten», «Regiomontan», «Tetragonum,», «Trigonum».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-15 px measured).
